> `content/docs/releases/` is RELEASE-OWNED (AGENTS.md "Documentation Guardrails"): release
> notes are written centrally at release time, and a code PR that edits them is the exact PR
> that guardrail exists to stop. They are still audited — read-only. If one of them is actually
> wrong, **file an issue** or open a dedicated docs-only PR; do not edit it here.

<details><summary>What this run could not see</summary>

- **1** anchor(s) matched too much of the corpus to be a work list: `sys_user (symbol, 38 pages)`
- **4** name(s) were too generic to anchor anything (single lowercase words)
- the SDK route bridge reached **54** of **206** client-bound route-ledger rows — the other **152** have no registrar `path:` tail to select them, so pages documenting THEIR client methods cannot appear above, on this or any run. Of those **152**: **0** are remediable by widening that discovery convention (an in-repo file declares the path; the convention did not scan it); **55** are structural — on a ledger where NOT ONE row is declared in-repo, so no discovery change reaches them at any price; **97** are undecided (no in-repo declaration, on a ledger that has other in-repo registrars — absence and an unreadable spelling are not distinguishable here). The rows themselves: `node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs --bridge-coverage`
- a page that states a rule by its **inputs** shares no identifier with the **emitter** that implements the rule, so an emitter-only diff cannot list it — not on this run and not on any run. Measured on #11430: `content/docs/protocol/objectql/types.mdx` documents the text-family column mapping by the ObjectQL type names it maps FROM (`text` / `textarea` / `html`) while the diff changed `createColumn`; it went unlisted, and it was the page that diff falsified, in four places. No shared token exists to detect this on, so a rule your change carries has to be re-read by hand in the pages that restate it.
- a key NAME is not a key, so the hand re-read the line above prescribes can land on the wrong schema. The same spelling is authorable on one governed type and a `[REMOVED]` tombstone on another for each of `active`, `aria`, `joins`, `objects`, `template`, `tools` and `version` (censused on #19093 over the liveness ledger's governed types, top-level keys); nothing in a search result distinguishes the two, so a grep hit on a LIVE example reads as evidence about the DEAD key. Measured on #19059: `content/docs/ai/agents.mdx` was reported as contradicting the `agent.tools` tombstone over its `tools:` example at `:161`, which is inside the `defineSkill({` block opened at `:155` — the page was already correct. Settle ownership by PARSING the value against both schemas, never by the name: that literal PASSES `SkillSchema`, and as an `AgentSchema` it FAILS at `tools` with the tombstone prescription. ⛔ These names are not the whole class — a key retired through a `.strict()` guidance map leaves no tombstone in the walked shape and none of them here (`tool.category`, live as `AIToolDefinition.category`).

Coarse fallback — **48** page(s) merely *mention* a changed package (the pre-#9192 predicate, kept for the deliberately-wide backstop): `node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs --json d78a0bda07c4bed2e3b71e051ac5db2632b82741` → `packageMentionDocs`.
</details>

<details><summary>Which tree this was computed on</summary>

This run read `content/docs` from `011803aa25faed5ae77bbc5d95b0c0cd44537c7f` — the merge of head `1432546ac85aa5a7b150f27d0c7c8a5bb22d3dcb` into base `d78a0bda07c4bed2e3b71e051ac5db2632b82741`, which is what `actions/checkout` gives a `pull_request` run. **Not** the PR head.

A worktree cut from an older `main` holds a different `content/docs`, so re-deriving there can legitimately return a different list — that is a **different tree, not a wrong row**. To answer on the same tree:

```sh
# while this PR is open — GitHub drops the merge commit once it closes
git fetch origin 011803aa25faed5ae77bbc5d95b0c0cd44537c7f && git checkout 011803aa25faed5ae77bbc5d95b0c0cd44537c7f
# afterwards, rebuild it from the two parents, which stay fetchable
git fetch origin d78a0bda07c4bed2e3b71e051ac5db2632b82741 1432546ac85aa5a7b150f27d0c7c8a5bb22d3dcb && git checkout -B drift-repro d78a0bda07c4bed2e3b71e051ac5db2632b82741 && git merge --no-ff 1432546ac85aa5a7b150f27d0c7c8a5bb22d3dcb

node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs --json d78a0bda07c4bed2e3b71e051ac5db2632b82741
```

⚠️ That checkout carried **uncommitted changes**, so the commit above does not fully identify what was read.
</details>

> Advisory only, and a **precision-first** one (#9192): a page is listed because it names a
> symbol, wire route or SDK method this diff touched — not because it mentions a changed
> package. Each row says which anchor put it there, so a wrong row is reportable rather than
> merely annoying. To re-verify, run the `docs-accuracy-audit` workflow scoped to these files:
> `node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs d78a0bda07c4bed2e3b71e051ac5db2632b82741` → pass the list as
> `args.docs`, on the commit named under **Which tree this was computed on**.

## Contract review

Served-tier: `CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER`
Head-sha: `1432546ac85aa5a7b150f27d0c7c8a5bb22d3dcb`
Local-runs: none

Read-only, at tier, adversarial to the dispatch. Inputs: card #20513 (body and all 29 comments — the census 5900801368, the ruling 5902360492 「20513 A」 A / A, the services pointer 5903999785, the stage-5 claim 5916824275, the stage-5 `os-dev-report` 5918105255), PR #20924 (body, 39-file list, the net diff `origin/main...1432546ac8` at merge base `4d0b9cd542`), PR #20848 at `a94f3bad3` with its record 5910833957 (which held the `findOne` pair) and PR #20877 at `42d78b97f` with its record 5913631724 as the prior applications of the same ruling, the head's check-runs, the 38 cited cards, the five ADRs the rewritten strings keep, and the head's own source through `git show` / `git grep` / `git diff` (the ledger parsed at the merge base, at `origin/main` and at the head). Nothing built, run or re-run; no worktree, no checkout. The PR head was confirmed as `1432546ac85aa5a7b150f27d0c7c8a5bb22d3dcb` (branch `claude/issue-20513-stage5-seven-packages`, draft, `Part of #20513`, no closing keyword, `mergeable: true`) before the read and had not moved.

**Check-runs on `1432546ac8`, read once for this record (2026-09-30T19:36Z is the write; the read preceded it) and not polled:** 31 check-runs — 12 `completed` / `success` (Check Changeset, Check PR Size, Check Documentation Links, Flag docs affected by code changes, Governed Surface Queue Guard, Part-of PR must not also close its card, The card this PR closes must claim this branch, the two claim / single-writer guards, Type Check · source gates, Auto Label, filter), 3 `skipped` (Build Docs, Console Pin Gate, Packed-tarball smoke — path-filtered), 16 `in_progress` (Test Core 1/6 to 6/6, Dogfood Regression Gate 1/3 to 3/3, Dogfood Verify CLI, Temporal Conformance (live PG + MySQL), Build Core, Lint & Repo Gates, Type Check · consumer gates, · debt ledger and · workspace), 0 `failure`; one commit status, Vercel, `success`. Their conclusions are the gate verdicts: the runs still going carry `check:doc-authoring`, `check:i18n` and `check:i18n-stale-fill` (Lint & Repo Gates), the eight re-pinned assertions and the `findOne` parity test (Test Core), and the lanes the dev did not measure. This record judges the contract on the diff, the cards and the head's source; a `failure` among the sixteen open runs, if one lands, is a new fact for the adopting session, not one this record has read.

### ① Derived judgments

**Scope against the ruling and the claim — right.** The ruling orders stages per package until the ledger is empty, all three categories, form D, `--census-ledger` in the same PR, author-visible text first and log lines last; the claim scopes stage 5 to the seven packages' `src/**`, the held `objectql` `findOne` string with its `metadata-core` twin, `driver-memory`'s URL-form id, the ledger and a `patch` changeset per package, and forbids wire `code` / field / status changes, comment or docblock edits (#20595) and other lanes' ledger rows. The 39-file list is exactly that surface: 29 source files (28 in the seven packages, plus `objectql` `engine.ts` at the held string only), 8 test files, the ledger, the changeset. No governed path. The order inside the stage is honoured as commit order: `0a25891e6d` the `findOne` pair on both faces, `69aace736f` the author-visible refusals and metadata text, `6e2d61d158` the `en` bundle regenerated, `4e33fedc49` the log lines last, `214951a19c` the changeset, then one merge of `origin/main` (`1432546ac8`, whose second parent is the merge base `4d0b9cd542`, on `origin/main`).

**Text only — right, checked line by line, with the two exceptions the dev names.** The net diff changes 151 lines in the 29 source files; a filter for changed lines without a string delimiter returns 4, all removals in the two tenancy guards: a blank line and `const tracking =` / `? ISSUE_URL` in `memory-tenancy-guard.ts`, a blank line in `mongodb-tenancy-guard.ts`. Every other changed source line sits inside a string literal or is the literal token of a one-line entry. No `code`, `status`, export, field name, branch or call moves: `MULTI_TENANT_UNSUPPORTED_CODE` (both spellings) is a context line, every `throw`, `logger.*` / `ctx.logger.*` call, `err.code = StandardErrorCode.enum.*` and `err.status = ...` is a context line, and `internal: true` on the three `sys_account` token fields is untouched. Comments and docblocks in `src/` are untouched; the only comment edit is two lines in `memory-tenant-scope-refusal.test.ts` beside the re-pinned assertion (③ item 8).

**The tenancy-guard removal — text only in effect, and the widening is right.** What leaves is two module-private `const` URLs (never exported; nothing on the head references `ISSUE_URL` or `CALL_SEAM_ISSUE_URL`), a local ternary that only composed the removed line, and the trailing `Tracking: ...` line of each message. The refusal itself is unchanged: the same `Error` subclass, the same `code`, the `seam` parameter still varies only the wording, the headline and the consequence sentence ("Rather than run unisolated, the driver fails at startup." / "Rather than answer it unisolated, the driver refuses it.") are context lines, and no test anywhere on the head compares the full message or a `Tracking:` fragment (`git grep` over every `.ts` for `Tracking:` and the three `issues/NNNN` URLs: 0 hits; the `plugin-dev` consumer test asserts `code: MEMORY_MULTI_TENANT_UNSUPPORTED` only). The claim names `driver-memory`'s URL-form id; the same line carried a second URL on both seams and `driver-mongodb`'s twin guard carried the same line with its own URL. Taking all three is the bounded-fix reading: same defect class as the card (a tracker number in author-visible refusal prose, spelled as a URL), mechanical, inside this stage's file surface (`driver-mongodb/src/**` is stage 5), and no new verification surface. Leaving the mongodb line would have left an author-visible tracker number in a stage-5 package after the stage meant to empty it. A `git grep` of the seven packages' non-test `src/` on the head for `github.com/objectstack-ai/objectstack/(issues|pull)/` returns nothing.

**Accept-set and public surface — nothing moves — right.** No schema, filter grammar, route, wire `code`, HTTP status, field name, default or export changes; a caller sees different prose in the same envelopes (`INVALID_QUERY` / 400, `NOT_IMPLEMENTED` / 501, `INVALID_FILTER` / 400, the boot and per-call tenancy refusals, the thrown `[Kernel]` and `[MetadataPlugin]` errors). The regenerated `en` bundle and the three translated bundles change four help values each way and nothing else — no key added or dropped, no structure moved.

**Ledger diff — right, exact, recounted independently.** Parsing `scripts/doc-authoring-prose-id.baseline.json` at the merge base (byte-identical to `origin/main` today) and at the head: files 200 to 175, (file, id) pairs 485 to 441, occurrences 722 to 653. Exactly 27 rows move and no row is added or grows: 25 rows leave (the six `core` files, `filter-refusal.ts`, `mongodb-aggregation.ts`, `mongodb-filter.ts`, `matches-filter.ts`, `engine-dispatch-unhonoured-predicate.ts`, the five `metadata` files, `objectql` `engine.ts`, the four `objects.generated.ts` bundles, `sys-email.object.ts`, `sys-account.object.ts`, `sys-scim-connection-credential.object.ts`, `platform-objects` `plugin.ts`) and 2 shrink (`engine-findone-predicate.ts` 4 to 3 with `#4419` gone; `engine-update-dispatch.ts` 20 to 18 with `#11142` and `#11230` each 5 to 4). The seven packages plus `objectql` go from 101 occurrences in 31 files to 32 in 6, matching the PR body's per-file table row for row. Every one of the 69 removed occurrences reconciles against a citation deleted in the source diff. No row outside these packages moves (0). `check:doc-authoring` inside Lint & Repo Gates is the mechanical confirmation, pending at read time; its printed site count (615 to 549) is the gate's own and is not re-derived here.

**The `findOne` pair — right, both faces in one commit, byte-identical on the head.** `engine.ts` `requireFindOnePredicate` (about 11562-11567) and `metadata-core`'s `engineFindOnePredicateRefusalMessage` (about 128-133) carry the same six template pieces, character for character, citation gone from both. `objectql`'s `engine-findone-predicate.test.ts` compares them by strict equality (about 95, `message === engineFindOnePredicateRefusalMessage(OBJECT)`) and by `toThrow(engineFindOnePredicateRefusalMessage(OBJECT))` (about 123). The dev's ablation (9 parity cases red with the `metadata-core` face alone re-marked, through the `dist/` leg) is its own measurement; the byte identity on the head is what this record verified. Stage 3's hold is discharged and `objectql`'s row leaves the ledger.

**Form D, string by string — right.** Of the 38 cited cards, 36 read `closed` / `completed`; `#12140` and `#16589` answer 404, and their sentences were judged against the head's code; `#11663` is open (the platform-admin re-anchor design card), but the sentence that cited it describes the L2 landing (`#11970`, closed), which is on the head. No cited decision has been reversed. The nine literals that gained words, each judged against the card and the head's code:
- `IMetadataService.register` non-document refusal (7378 row 3): "so the contract refuses loudly and never coerces a value into storability". The card's row 3 records accept-then-drop as the indefensible answer and refusal as the consistent one; `assertMetadataRegisterContract` throws `registerRefusal` on a non-object `data`. True.
- `IMetadataService.register` name-disagreement refusal (7378 row 1): "so the contract refuses loudly and names the mismatch". The card's candidate (c), refuse loudly rather than silently resolve either way, is what the code does, and the message names both spellings. True.
- Init-order fault suffix (4131): "a composition/ordering fault; registration order is not a contract." The card's finding is that ordering was an unenforced convention; `plugin-order.ts` enforces `requiresServices` at init and its own violation text (about 144) already reads "Registration order is not a contract — declare ...". True.
- `admin_full_access` row reason (8613): "(ADR-0049 `active`, which this resolver honours)". `resolve-authz-context.ts` filters permission-set rows through `isRowActive` (about 1031) and positions likewise (about 1006-1011). True.
- `sys_user` row reason (11663 L2): "RECLASSIFIED from `reads-only` when the config anchor landed". The §6b-config anchor (`OS_PLATFORM_OWNER_EMAIL` matched against the caller's own `sys_user` row) is on the head at about 1073 of the same file. True.
- MongoDB retired-aggregate refusal (6188): "(ADR-0049 enforce-or-remove: no SQL backend compiled it)". `#6188` asked exactly that question of `count_distinct` / `array_agg` / `string_agg`; the spec's `AggregationFunction` today keeps `count_distinct` and retires the other two with `AGG_RETIRED_MIDDLE` reading "was removed from AggregationFunction in @objectstack/spec 17 (ADR-0049 enforce-or-remove) — no SQL backend ever compiled it"; `refuseRetiredAggregateFunction` is reached for those two names only. True, and the same reason the spec records.
- MongoDB undeclared-aggregate refusal (5907, 12818): "before this refusal, this builder answered any unrecognised name with a $sum of that column". `#12818`'s title is that silent SUM; the head's `undeclaredAggregateFunctionError` refuses and the file's own header says the switch's `default` answered a `$sum`. True.
- HMR route ledger note (12140): "CHANGED when the development-only mount gate landed". `hmr-routes.ts` (about 114-118) opens the door only under a literal `NODE_ENV=development` through `isDevMetadataEndpointEnabled`, and its docblock records the gate as the change. True.
- History-seq error (4825): "numbering it from 1 (what this code once did)". `#4825`'s title is exactly that (静默从 1 重新发号). True.

Where only the citation goes (the other literals): each sentence already carried the decision and is otherwise unchanged — the three retired health-check keys (12032), the plugin-ordering violation and the `requiresServices` prescription (4131), the superseded-registration warning (9864), the §6b-config clause (11970), the authz cache posture line (4785), the nine `driver-memory` filter refusals (10413, 5158, 5240, 3948, 4286, 5345, 5324, 5328, 5347), the MongoDB date-bucket, per-aggregation-filter and declared-but-uncompiled refusals (6212, 10413, 5907) and its four filter refusals (5158, 5347, 5240, 5346), formula's empty-constraint refusal (5240), the by-id unhonoured-predicate and the two update id-conflict refusals (11009, 11142, 11230), the endpoint matcher's excluded-item error (5040 E7), the degraded-list warning (5184), the retired `artifact-api` source (4246), the `sys_account` token helps (7987), the `sys_email` headers help (8149), the SCIM protection reason (3653) and the two attestation info lines (4795). Where an ADR stood beside the number, the ADR stays and resolves on the head: ADR-0049 (health monitor, admin standing, MongoDB retired aggregate), ADR-0078 (the uncompilable-operator refusal), ADR-0104 (the attestation lines), ADR-0121 (the endpoint matcher), ADR-0134 (the SCIM store).

**Generated translations — right, and it follows the repo's i18n rule.** AGENTS.md's guardrail row for `**/translations/*.generated.ts` says the file *structure* is never hand-edited and is regenerated with `node scripts/check-i18n-bundles.mjs --write` (merge mode keeps every translated-locale value; `en` is rewritten from the source), and that translated-locale *values* are hand-written: editing one is fine, adding or dropping keys is drift. The generator itself prints the same rule ("Merge mode is on for translated locales, so no existing translation is overwritten"). So the number inside the es-ES / ja-JP / zh-CN token helps can leave only by hand, and the dev's reading of the order's "never by hand" against AGENTS.md is the right one (AGENTS.md wins over any other instruction). Verified on the diff: `en.objects.generated.ts` changes the four leaves whose source changed and nothing else; each translated bundle changes exactly the three `sys_account` token helps, and every edited value differs from the base by the parenthesised number alone (`(#7987)` / `（#7987）`), so each still says what the new English says. Keys and structure untouched (3 changed lines per bundle, all `help:` values). None of the twelve edited leaves has a `*.source-hashes.generated.ts` companion entry (0 hits in all three), so `check:i18n-stale-fill`, which reads those companions, has nothing to trip on; `check:i18n` is the bundle-drift gate and the `en` bundle is regenerated. Both run inside Lint & Repo Gates, pending at read time.

**Pins — right, 8 assertions in 8 files, each phrase on the head.** `health-monitor.test.ts` asserts `in @objectstack/spec 17.3.0 (ADR-0049 enforce-or-remove)`, contiguous at runtime in all three retired-key messages; `authz-cache-posture.test.ts` asserts the full "a silently-absent invalidation bridge ... without anyone noticing." sentence, which spans a `+` boundary in the source and is one sentence at runtime; the two MongoDB retired-aggregate tests assert `(ADR-0049 enforce-or-remove: no SQL backend compiled it)`; the three tenancy tests assert the consequence sentences ("Rather than run unisolated," / "Rather than answer it unisolated, the driver refuses it."); `objectql` `engine-update-dispatch.test.ts` asserts "and any declared multi:true — silently ignored.", present across the `+` boundary. None of the eight files still asserts its old number. The dev's mutation legs are its own measurement. A sweep of every test file on the head for a matcher on any of the 38 removed ids finds three unrelated hits: `rest`'s truncation fixture's *negative* pin on its own copy of the `$null` sentence, `runtime`'s `endpoint-executor.test.ts` pinning a `runtime` string (`#5040 §7-3`, another lane's row), and `check-prerelease-pin-watch.mjs`'s self-test reading its own follow-up-card constant. No consumer pins a changed string.

**Review faces — right, with one wording note.** The changeset (below) reads as a CHANGELOG entry: every family it names is in the diff and each sentence it summarises matches the string, including the MongoDB retirement reason and the `Tracking:` line removal. The PR body's table, per-file ledger rows, commit order, 5b inventory and whole-ledger numbers match the diff and the recount above; it carries `Clause-②: no` at line start and no closing keyword. The metadata texts an administrator reads: the three `sys_account` token helps say "never returned on the data API; better-auth reads it back through the engine's privileged internal-field accessor" — the fields are `internal: true` and `plugin-auth`'s `internal-field-readback.ts` is the accessor named; the `sys_email` headers help and the SCIM protection reason lose the number and nothing else. The note: the changeset does not name the two ledger-prose families (the admin-standing-surface reasons and the metadata route-ledger note); they fall under its opening sentence and are not author-facing refusals, so nothing is misstated. Carrier: none.

### ② Semver level

`.changeset/20513-seven-packages-runtime-strings-state-the-decision.md`: `patch` for `@objectstack/core`, `driver-memory`, `driver-mongodb`, `formula`, `metadata`, `metadata-core`, `objectql` and `platform-objects` — right. All eight are released (`17.5.0`, none `private`); the diff publishes changed prose in each of them and nothing else — no key, export, envelope `code`, status or default moves — so this is a fix-class patch in each, never `skip-changeset`. The body is CHANGELOG-fit: it names each message family, says which sentences gained words and what they now say, explains the `findOne` pair and the `Tracking:` line, and closes "Text only: no error code, field name, status or behaviour changes". No model identifier in the changeset, the five commit trailers (`Claude-Session` plus a model-free `Co-authored-by`; the merge commit carries none) or the PR body (session-URL footer) — the shape stages 1 to 4 landed with. Check Changeset is `success`.

Clause-②: no — right. Nothing an author can write is widened or narrowed; the PR body carries `Clause-②: no` at line start and the changeset repeats it.

### ③ Boundary flags
